statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope
There is concern for an underlying paroxysmal cardiac arrhythmia
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
The procedure is indicated to capture potential rhythm disturbances during symptomatic periods
The diagnosis codes are R55 and I49.9
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
